thread:
jamie: quick heads-up — ambiguity with streaming function chunks. repro below, need a quick opinion before I file an RFC.

jamie: repro: model streams deltas with content and func deltas. some backends flush func args as multiple chunks and clients reassemble. example stream payload (simplified):
```
{event: 'delta', role: 'assistant', content: 'Processing...'}
{event: 'delta', role: 'assistant', func_call: {name: 'search', args: '{\"q\": \"redwood\"}'}}
{event: 'delta', role: 'assistant', func_call: {name: 'search', args: '\" page\": 1}'}}
{event: 'end', finish_reason: 'tool_call'}
```

jamie: q1) do we guarantee ordering so clients can concat func_call.args safely? (i.e., no interleaving with other event types)
jamie: q2) should we formalize a chunk envelope (seq/id/final) instead of relying on concatenation?
jamie: q3) backward compat: old clients expect a single `tool_call` final payload and might double-apply reassembly logic.

alex: ordering is generally preserved from runtime -> client, but there are edge cases when batching/kernels flush out of chunk order (rare). we shouldn't rely on implicit concat for correctness.

sam: my 2c: I prefer explicit chunk meta. even something small: {event: 'func_chunk', id: 'abc', idx: 0, final: false, data: '...'}
that makes reassembly deterministic and lets proxies re-chunk safely.

pat: compatibility q: if we add func_chunk, do we emit both old-style func_call deltas and new func_chunk? or make it opt-in header for clients? old HTTP streaming clients might break if they expect role/content merge semantics.

maria: opt-in header seems safest: X-Redwood-Streaming-Func: chunked | concat
- default remains concat to preserve existing behavior
- chunked gives metadata and guarantees no interleaving w/o reordering

jamie: +1 on opt-in. also propose a small invariant: when chunked mode is enabled, runtime will emit a final {event: 'func_end', id: 'abc', complete: true, finish_reason: 'tool_call'} so clients can detect completion without scanning for finish_reason only.

alex: agree. also add seq numbers to allow detection of missing chunks and surfaces a retry/error event: {event: 'func_missing', id: 'abc'}

sam: implementation note: SDKs should expose a reassembler that yields two modes: streaming-assembled-text (same as current) or chunked-objects (deliver partial JSON values as they arrive). devex can provide helpers.

ci-bot: <ci-bot> RFC template created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-rfcs/pull/123 (stub)

maria: i can draft the RFC tonight — will include examples for streaming over websockets + server-sent-events, plus a migration guide for old clients.

pat: one more thing — telemetry. add a small metric when chunked mode is used so Dedicated customers can opt-in and we can monitor errors during rollout.

jamie: thanks all. action items:
- maria: RFC draft (PR link when ready)
- eng-runtime: add header support + func_chunk event (opt-in)
- devex/SDKs: reassembler helpers
- infra: telemetry flag

jamie: pinging @maria @alex @sam for early review on the RFC when it's up :thumbsup: 

alex: will review tomorrow morning.

sam: likewise, will sketch SDK helper in a branch.

maria: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/inference-rfcs/pull/123 — comments welcome, will iterate.

jamie: cool — closing this quick check. thanks :rocket:
